subject: MSA / Order Form: CedarPoint security exhibit redlines, pen-test window & evidence rhythm
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Morgan Sweeney <morgan.sweeney@cedarpointhealth.org>
Cc: procurement@cedarpointhealth.org
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: CedarPoint MSA / Order Form — initial security exhibit redlines and pen-test ask

Hi team,

Attaching the first pass of the security exhibit redlines for the MSA + order form (see CedarPoint_MSA_redlines_20260511.docx). Key items we want to resolve before final legal review:

- Audit rights: propose bounded, staged inspection rather than open-ended privileged inspection.
- Pen test: request a 72-hour notice and a 5-business-day staging window; vendor to provide scope and test plan in advance.
- SOC 2: CedarPoint will accept the latest SOC 2 Type II report plus an evidence cadence instead of continuous live access.
- Evidence cadence: suggest weekly evidence snapshots (every Monday) for a 6-week onboarding period, then monthly thereafter.

Morgan / CedarPoint procurement — can you confirm whether a 2nd-week-of-June pen-test window (target) works for you and whether the weekly snapshot cadence is acceptable? If you prefer an alternative cadence, note that we can propose a staggered schedule to minimize operational load.

Next steps:
1) Internal: legal (Karthik) to propose alternative clause language for limited inspection and ephemeral staging creds.
2) Ops (Monica) to confirm what evidence sets we can deliver on a weekly cadence and what requires additional lead time.
3) Procurement: confirm preferred pen-test window and whether SOC 2 + evidence matrix suffices.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_matrix_cedarpoint.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Morgan Sweeney <morgan.sweeney@cedarpointhealth.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cedarpointhealth.org
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint MSA / Order Form — initial security exhibit redlines and pen-test ask

Hi Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the early draft and clear asks. A few quick points from CedarPoint procurement/security:

- We are sensitive to broad "inspection" language. We can accept a bounded inspection if it includes: a) documented scope, b) mutually agreed schedule, and c) an option for remote evidence review in lieu of on-site access.
- Pen test window: the 2nd week of June (June 14–18) is preferred by our security team; we need the vendor's test plan at least 10 business days before the window.
- SOC 2: we will accept a current Type II report, but we also need a commitment to provide the specific artifact list (evidence matrix) on a predictable cadence. Weekly snapshots initially sound heavy; can we consider weekly for onboarding (first 4 weeks) and then bi-weekly for the next 8 weeks before moving to monthly?

I'll loop in our security lead if we need to get more granular on the pen-test scope. For now: the suggested pen-test window (June 14–18) and a front-loaded evidence tempo (4 weeks weekly then bi-weekly) would be our preference.

Morgan
Morgan Sweeney
Procurement Manager, CedarPoint Health
morgan.sweeney@cedarpointhealth.org
Phone: (415) 555-0104

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Sweeney <morgan.sweeney@cedarpointhealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@cedarpointhealth.org
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint MSA / Order Form — initial security exhibit redlines and pen-test ask

Hi Morgan — appreciate the quick feedback and the pref dates.

High-level response (we'll get legal language to you shortly):
- Inspection/Access: Redwood is open to a "limited inspection" approach. Draft compromise: vendor will provide a documented evidence matrix and remote access for reviewers; privileged on-prem inspection will be limited to a pre-notified, scheduled staging environment and only where necessary. We will include a clause for emergency audit (incident-driven) with defined scope and notice periods.
- Pen testing: June 14–18 is acceptable on our side. We'll provide a draft pen-test plan by May 29 to meet your 10-business-day ask. We propose ephemeral staging credentials (time-limited) and a requirement that tests avoid production systems; redline attached clarifies scope.
- Evidence cadence: agreed to front-load. Proposed: weekly snapshots for 4 weeks, then bi-weekly for 8 weeks, then monthly. Monica — please confirm the minimum evidence set we can reliably produce on a weekly cadence (I tagged an evidence matrix).

Karthik — can you provide precise MSA clause wording for: 1) bounded inspection rights, 2) notice & scheduling for pen tests, and 3) evidence delivery SLAs? If you can get that into the redline doc, we can circulate back to CedarPoint legal for sign-off.

Thanks — I'll circle back with the revised redline by Friday.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Morgan Sweeney <morgan.sweeney@cedarpointhealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@cedarpointhealth.org
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed clause language — limited inspection & pen-test scheduling

Laura / Morgan — draft language below for insertion into the security exhibit (MSA):

--- DRAFT CLAUSES (for negotiation) ---
1) Limited Inspection. Customer may request inspection limited to (a) review of the evidence matrix and supporting artifacts, and (b) access to a mutually agreed staging environment for a maximum of five (5) business days per 12-month period, provided Customer gives at least ten (10) business days' prior written notice. Inspection requests will include a proposed scope and list of reviewers; Redwood may require redaction of PHI or other regulated data prior to access.

2) Penetration Testing. Customer may conduct or engage a third party to conduct penetration testing of Redwood's non-production staging environment only, provided: (a) Customer submits a written test plan at least ten (10) business days prior to the proposed test window; (b) tests are limited to the mutually agreed scope and do not target production; (c) all findings are coordinated through Redwood's security team and not publicly disclosed without mutual consent.

3) Evidence Delivery SLA. Redwood will provide an evidence matrix with links to supporting artifacts. During onboarding, Redwood will deliver weekly evidence snapshots for four (4) consecutive weeks, then bi-weekly for the following eight (8) weeks, and monthly thereafter. Redwood will notify Customer at least five (5) business days in advance of any deviation to the cadence.

--- end draft ---

Morgan / CedarPoint: if this captures the negotiated position, we'll put these clauses into the redline and return for your legal review. If you need shorter notice periods or different day counts, flag which clause and we'll evaluate operationally.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: CedarPoint MSA / Order Form — evidence capability and ops notes

Hi all,

Quick ops confirmation on evidence and staging:

- Evidence matrix: the file attached outlines the artifacts we can deliver and the lead times. For the weekly onboarding snapshots we can reliably produce the following minimal set: SOC 2 report (latest Type II), access control mapping (screenshot + CSV), encryption key management summary (KMS metadata, no secret material), and recent vulnerability scanning report (non-production). Anything requiring deeper logs (e.g., full audit log exports beyond 30 days) will need additional lead time — typically 7–10 business days.
- Staging access: we can stand up ephemeral creds tied to an IP allowlist for the June 14–18 window. Credentials will auto-expire and we will audit staging sessions.
- Pen-test coordination: please send the test plan to security@redwood.com by May 29. We'll route to the ops pen-test lead and provide a confirmation within 3 business days.

Morgan — based on your earlier note, your proposed cadence (weekly x4 -> bi-weekly x8 -> monthly) is operationally feasible for the minimal set. If you elect a larger artifact set than the minimal, we'll need longer lead times.

Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
